facts.fact: Article 6 as amended by Law 2023-31 creates the Haute Autorité de Protection des Données à caractère Personnel (HAPDP), attached to the Presidency, and Articles 7 and 8 as amended by Ordinance 2024-29 set a 10-member composition with members named by decree in the Council of Ministers; the document states no appointment actually made.
facts.system: Loi n° 2022-59 du 16 décembre 2022 relative à la protection des données à caractère personnel
